verdict.rationale: Superpowers' own install path for Codex and OpenCode has the agent fetch and follow a raw GitHub INSTALL.md, which is an agent-run install route. A recorded runtime probe also shows a fully headless, flag-driven (`-y`) install of one skill completing end to end, though it used the generic `skills` CLI rather than a Superpowers-owned installer. Other documented paths are harness-native commands (Claude Code `/plugin`, `devin plugins install`), and docs say everything ships through the harness's own install mechanism. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a promptless, non-interactive install mode; evidence that the agent-driven INSTALL.md path runs without human confirmation; a first-party headless installer rather than the host `skills` CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can install a skill by itself — a non-interactive, promptless install path an agent can run headlessly end to end

citations.quote: you tell the agent to fetch and follow instructions from a raw GitHub INSTALL.md

a REAL end-to-end keyless install into a scratch project dir — `npx -y skills add obra/superpowers --skill test-driven-development -a claude-code -y --copy` fetched the repo, copied the skill to ./.claude/skills/test-driven-development/
`devin plugins install obra/superpowers` now works, and skills auto-trigger at session start.
